regimeSub: Fed Chair Warsh holds at 4% with Cook-dissent signaling hike bias; CPI 4% vs 3% core PCE keeps stagflation alive.
themes: FOMC Oct decision: Warsh holds at 4.0% in split vote per CNBC/Fortune — Gov Lisa Cook dissented hawkish (first dual dissent since 1992); Warsh signals fewer meetings ahead, keeps Dec hike optionality as Sep CPI sticky at 4.0% YoY
10Y yield +1bp to 4.99% post-FOMC per CNBC 'yields creep higher' → 2s10s steepens to +29bp; JP Morgan says bonds a buy but hawkish dissent keeps term premium bid as real rate stays negative at 0%
Brent crude eases to $110.20 from $111 as Saudi disruption fears fade per WSJ; gold -$10 to $4,049 as inflation hedge unwinds modestly but stays elevated on stagflation regime persistence
KOSPI reclaims 6,000 on Anthropic-SK Hynix strength per Chosun Ilbo; USDKRW -3 to 1335 as BOK seen hiking Nov per Herald → hawkish divergence from Fed hold supports won
